paragraphs.text: Guilds of Ravnica is the 79th Magic expansion. It was released on October 5, 2018. Officially, it is not part of a block . However, it is part of a series of three that is set on the same world, unofficially called the Guilds of Ravnica block .

Guilds of Ravnica contains 259 cards (111 commons, 80 uncommons, 53 rares, and 15 mythic rares), but there are only 254 functionally different cards since all gates have 2 common slots. Boosters may include randomly inserted premium versions of any card. The name of the set is rather similar to the Ravnica: City of Guilds , but Wizards of the Coast doesn't perceive this as a problem. The set features five of the bi-colored Ravnican guilds : Selesnya ( ), Boros ( ), Golgari ( ), Izzet ( ), and Dimir ( ). Watermarks are used to better identify the guilds. To get a guild watermark, the card has to be two-color, optimized with two colors or use the guild keyword.

The 5 basic lands of this set are not included within the 259 cards, meaning that they won't appear in booster packs but only in the planeswalker decks and the Bundle . They're all autumnal versions of the 5 Richard Wright basics from Ravnica: City of Guilds and are numbered from #260/259 to #264/259. Neither contained in boosters are the 8 additional planeswalker deck exclusive cards - numbered #265/259 to #272/259 - and the Buy-a-Box promo, which has the number #273/259. Each Guildgate is featured in two common slots, each with different art, much like Wastes in Oath of the Gatewatch .

It is autumn on Ravnica . The story occurs mostly in darkness with shadows and moodiness, similar to a film noir . The story gears up for the final showdown with Nicol Bolas . He is trying to slowly influence Ravnica and warp it to his needs. The guilds fight internally between the forces pulling them toward or away from Bolas's influence.

The cards that represent the Story Spotlights in Guilds of Ravnica are: Thousand-Year Storm ( ), Guild Summit ( ), Assassin's Trophy ( ), and Firemind's Research ( ). The story spotlight cards no longer tell you the order they occur in.

Guilds of Ravnica is sold in 16-card boosters (one card being a marketing card ), two planeswalker decks and the Guilds of Ravnica bundle . Building on how Theme Boosters for Dominaria performed, these 35-card booster packs with one rare or mythic rare card make another appearance. Of course, they are themed around the appropriate guilds and thus bi-colored. The set is also accompanied by five special guild kits , preconstructed theme decks that combine cards from every Ravnica set released so far.
The boosters feature artwork of Emmara Tandris , Ral Zarek , Vraska , Aurelia , and a Dimir spy. Every one in eight booster packs includes a code good for three packs in MTG Arena .
Update Magic Arena : 27 September 2018 (free OpenBeta)

Prerelease took place on 29–30 September 2018. Prerelease packs contained 5 regular Guilds of Ravnica booster packs and one seeded booster composed entirely of cards relevant to that player's choice of guild. It also contains 1 randomized, date stamped foil promo card, drawn from any rare or mythic from the featured guild. All prerelease packs included an entry code to an MTG Arena Sealed event.

Local stores hosted Ravnica Weekend on November 9–11. Players could come in and play four-pack Drafts, casual Guild Kit battles, and a special preview adventure from the D&D Guildmasters' Guide to Ravnica .

Ravnica Weekend: one of ten special guild-affiliated premium foil promo basic lands . These are numbered A01/10 to A10/10. Non-foil versions of these basic lands appear in the Guild Kits, where they are numbered as part of the deck.
The sixteenth card in the boosters is a token card or an emblem , with advertisements on the back side. There are eight tokens and emblems in the set:
4/4 Angel creature with flying and vigilance , for Divine Visitation .

1/1 Bird Illusion creature with flying , for Murmuring Mystic .
1/1 Goblin creature, for Legion Warboss .
1/1 Insect creature, for Izoni, Thousand-Eyed .
2/2 Elf Knight creature with vigilance , for Assemble , Conclave Guildmage , Conclave Cavalier , and Sprouting Renewal .

Emblem for Vraska, Golgari Queen
Guilds of Ravnica Mythic Edition is a special draft -sized booster box , exclusively sold in the U.S and Canada. It contains eight masterpieces .
Each guild features a unique mechanic .

The expansion also features split cards . Each one focuses on a single guild, with a smallish hybrid mana effect as one half and a bigger, multicolor mana effect as the other. The art of the rares focuses on the two major characters (legendary creatures or planeswalkers) in that guild, one personality per side. The card halves have alliterative names, starting with the same three letters.
Guilds of Ravnica has fourteen cycles , two of which are reprints and one of which is printed twice within the set.
Guilds of Ravnica has one mirrored pair .

March of the Multitudes is a Selesnya cost spell completing an unintentional mega-mega cycle for each guild: the X spell cycle . Every other guild already has at least one from the previous Ravnica sets.
Invert // Invent required day-one errata : as printed, Invert's effect lasts indefinitely, where it should last until end of turn.
Thousand-Year Storm essentially gives Storm to other cards.
Etrata, the Silencer and Vraska, Golgari Queen are alternate-win cards .
Chance for Glory is an alternate-loss card .
Midnight Reaper 's illustration calls to mind a famous scene in The Lord Of the Rings movie.
Collar the Culprit and Citywide Bust are two related pictures illustrated by Victor Adame Minguez creating a mini story.

Arclight Phoenix is a unique success story amongst Mythic Rares: despite spawning its own archetype and having recurrent times in the spotlight as a top deck, it has rarely been considered oppressive. Its peak usage in Standard let it rotate with a large supply, making it a popular budget choice as the remaining deck is largely common and uncommon cantrips and interaction.
